facts.fact: The PADA terms of reference say Subcomponent 2.3 supports designing, piloting and expanding hybrid digital-skills programmes and courses at ENAPP, the national school of public administration, with a methodology to assess digital skills in the public sector.

systems.country_label: Escola Nacional de Administração e Políticas Públicas

facts.fact: The PADA terms of reference say Subcomponent 3.2 supports the Government in developing and implementing a national strategy for basic, intermediate and advanced digital skills for young and underemployed people, starting with a needs assessment.
